messages:
Anna Chen: quick check — the orientation invite shows 09:00 AM PT on my calendar but i had teammates in CET and IST. did the invite include timezone conversions?
Mike Patel: It should auto-convert in Google Calendar. If you imported the .ics manually maybe it kept local time. who is missing the right time?
Sophia Rivera: I’m in CET and it showed 6pm for me which is correct. Jordan (APAC) said it showed 9am for him too so i worried there were duplicate invites in my calendar.
Jordan Lee: i actually saw two separate invites (one from onboarding@ and one from calendar@redwood). i deleted the duplicate but wanted to confirm which one to keep.
Lee Thompson: Keep the one from onboarding@redwood.com — that’s the canonical invite with the Zoom link and recording settings. If you already joined the meeting from the other invite it’s fine but delete the duplicate to avoid double reminders.
Anna Chen: thanks — onboarding@ it is. also — will there be a recording? want to share with folks who can’t attend live (esp. APAC).
Onboarding Bot: Recording will be captured and uploaded to the onboarding bucket within ~30 min after session ends. Transcript + captions enabled.
Mike Patel: Zoom link (canonical): https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 passcode: 4R3dW0od. Please don’t share outside company.
Sophia Rivera: small nit — the calendar description still says "orientation v1" from last quarter. can someone update the description to include the agenda & where we store slides?
Jordan Lee: +1. also can we add a note for recording retention (2 months) so new hires know to download slides?
Lee Thompson: done — updated invite description with agenda + slides link + recording retention note. Slides live here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OnboardSlides
Anna Chen: i still don’t see the updated invite (maybe cached). any quick fix?
Mike Patel: try toggling the calendar subscription: Settings > Calendars > uncheck then recheck the Redwood Onboarding calendar; or remove the duplicate invite and accept the onboarding@ one again.
Onboarding Bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood-onboarding.s3.amazonaws.com/1771234567-orientation-recording.mp4 — transcript: https://redwood-onboarding.s3.amazonaws.com/1771234567-transcript.vtt
Anna Chen: awesome, got the recording link. thanks! one last thing — timezone label in the invite subject says PST. we switched to PT earlier this year; can we make it say PT to avoid confusion?
Lee Thompson: good catch. updated subject to include "09:00 PT / 18:00 CET" for clarity.
Sophia Rivera: thanks all. tagging @everyone scheduled for next week — please check your calendar and ping onboarding@redwood.com if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
